[[sn:Homeomorphic Graphs]][[File:Homeomorphic.jpg|thumb|Homeomorphic]]
Two graphs are homeomorphic if they can be made in essentially the same shape by adding a node into a line in it




If two graphs are homeomorphic then either both are [[Planar Graphs|planar]] or neither is planar

I'm confident on this
